question: What extensive preparatory process was carried out in the Shambhava branches?
premises: A sequence of acts such as sowing, implanting, and digging was performed.
This sequence was carried out by many branches of the Shambhava teaching.
inference: The Shambhava tradition developed an extensive preparatory sequence of practices across its many branches.
uncertainties: The agricultural imagery (sowing, implanting, digging) may be metaphorical for spiritual preparation; taken literally in gloss and metaphorically in sense.
plain_english: Where the very extensive sequence of acts such as sowing, implanting, and digging was carried out by the many branches of the Shambhava teaching.
